outcome: Decidual macrophage phenotype (CD86+ cells, CX3CR1+ cells, CD163+ cells)
TGFb relative protein level in decidual cells
cohort: The study included 43 patients diagnosed with early-onset preeclampsia or late-onset preeclampsia, and healthy controls.
finding: Early-onset preeclampsia showed significantly higher numbers of inflammation-associated CD86+ and CX3CR1+ decidual cells, increased endothelin-1 gene expression, decreased eNOS and GNB3 expression and TGFb protein levels in decidual cells, and elevated pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokines in plasma.
cross-section timing: Samples were obtained and analyzed from patients diagnosed with early-onset preeclampsia and late-onset preeclampsia, and controls, at the time of disease manifestation.
